description: M6 Ranking + Web UI / Rank -> Display (tasks.md T6.1-T6.9, FR-22-FR-38, AC-1/2/3/7/8/11). Add LocationProvider (Haversine + Null) and a CalendarProvider interface, the transparent weighted-sum ranking engine with stored ScoreComponents and deterministic tie-breaks, an explanation generator, the pipeline orchestrator (ingest->normalize->dedup->verify->score->save, idempotent upsert + history diff, CLI + seed/demo), and the server-rendered Flask web UI. This is the final integration feature: it wires FEAT-001..005 together into a running offline product. Depends on ALL prior FEATs.
steps: Create vandy_food_radar/providers/__init__.py, providers/location.py (LocationProvider Protocol walking(origin, dest) -> WalkingResult{distance_m?, minutes?, status}; HaversineLocationProvider computing straight-line distance from config.reference_location with coarse walking minutes; NullLocationProvider always status unknown), and providers/calendar.py (CalendarProvider Protocol + a no-op default; interface only, no auto-add per FR-39/40). Unknown walking must feed config.ranking.walking_unknown_value in scoring, never zero (FR-30, AC-8).

Create vandy_food_radar/ranking/__init__.py and ranking/engine.py: weighted-sum scorer using config.ranking.weights (exact design §6.1 defaults). Normalize each factor to [0,1] per §6.1 (food_confirmed 1/0.3/0; full_meal 1/0.4/0.2/0; food_specificity from description detail e.g. named menu items; rsvp_likelihood no-rsvp 1 / required+ok 0.7 / required+broken 0.3 / unknown 0.5; timing curve over config.ranking.timing_good_start_hour..end_hour; walking via provider with neutral fallback; confidence passthrough). Store one ScoreComponent per factor (raw_value, weight, contribution, note) and set Event.score_total. Ordering: score desc, then earlier start_time, then title asc; cancelled events forced to the bottom / segregated.

Create vandy_food_radar/ranking/explanation.py building a short human-readable 'why this rank' string from the top-contributing ScoreComponent notes (dinner-with-menu cites confirmed full meal + specific menu; refreshments cites vagueness / unconfirmed).

Create tests/test_ranking.py: dinner-with-menu outranks refreshments and A's explanation cites the confirmed full meal / specific menu (AC-3); ranking deterministic across two runs incl. scores, components, ordering (AC-2); changing a weight reorders predictably; unknown-walking uses the neutral default and neither zeroes nor crashes (AC-8).

Create vandy_food_radar/pipeline/__init__.py and pipeline/orchestrator.py: run(window, *, repository, sources, location_provider, config) -> RunReport threading ingest -> normalize -> dedup -> verify -> score -> save; idempotent upsert on dedup_key; diff against the stored event to append EventHistory on changed tracked fields (AC-11). Add a seed/demo helper that loads the fixture corpus and RETARGETS its dates onto the target day (tomorrow relative to now) so the DB always has content for the web view. Create vandy_food_radar/cli.py (+ __main__.py) exposing `seed` and `run` subcommands wiring the offline FixtureFetcher/adapters + SqliteRepository + Haversine provider.

Add Flask as a runtime dependency via `uv add flask` and build vandy_food_radar/web/app.py with create_app(config) that reads ONLY through the Repository. Main route: next-day events in ranked order as dense cards (templates/index.html + templates/_event_card.html + static/app.css) each showing title, time, location, food description, RSVP status, walking time (or 'unavailable'), source links, verification badge, and the ranking explanation; an expandable section lists recorded conflicts. Visibly distinguish states verified/partially_verified/conflicting/food_unconfirmed/cancelled (state styling, density-first). Add a 'Refresh now' POST that runs the pipeline for tomorrow.

Create tests/test_web.py (Flask test client over a seeded repo: GET '/' returns 200, events in ranked order, all required card fields + state badges present, 'Refresh now' triggers the pipeline) and tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py (full Discover->Display over the fixture corpus: two pizza-night sources merge to one event; career-mixer resolves to official 18:00 with 18:30 conflict preserved; cancelled event marked cancelled; dinner-with-menu outranks refreshments; final ordering/states as expected).

Add Makefile targets seed, run, and demo (demo = seed the corpus into SQLite with dates retargeted to tomorrow, then start Flask on localhost) and update README.md with the exact single command and localhost URL to launch the app and see ranked fixture events out of the box.
acceptance_criteria: LocationProvider (Haversine + Null) and CalendarProvider interfaces exist; reference location from config; unknown walking uses the neutral default and never zeroes the score (T6.1, FR-28/29/30, AC-7/AC-8).
Ranking is a transparent weighted sum using the exact §6.1 weights, stores a ScoreComponent breakdown, and orders deterministically with documented tie-breaks (T6.2, FR-22-27, AC-2).
An explanation string is generated from score components; dinner-with-menu outranks refreshments and the explanation cites the reason (T6.3/T6.4, FR-25, AC-3).
Pipeline orchestrator runs ingest->normalize->dedup->verify->score->save with idempotent upsert + history diff, callable from CLI and the web refresh action (T6.5, FR-42/43, AC-11).
Flask web UI shows next-day ranked dense cards with all required fields, verification badges, expandable conflicts, and state styling; reads only through the Repository (T6.6-T6.8, FR-34-38).
End-to-end fixture test asserts merge, conflict resolution to official time with preserved loser, cancellation, and full-meal>refreshments ordering (T6.9, AC-1).
make demo (or make seed + make run) starts the server and the page shows ranked fixture events; README documents the exact launch command.
uv run pytest passes for the new tests and `make check` is green.
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_ranking.py tests/test_web.py tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py
findings: Implemented the final integration feature (M6 Rank -> Display). New packages: providers/ (location.py: LocationProvider Protocol + WalkingResult/WalkingStatus, HaversineLocationProvider straight-line distance->coarse minutes from config.reference_location, NullLocationProvider always unknown, walking_factor_value maps to [0,1] and uses config.ranking.walking_unknown_value=0.5 when unknown (never 0); calendar.py: CalendarProvider Protocol + NullCalendarProvider no-op, interface-only, no auto-add). ranking/ (engine.py score_event(event,*,config,location_provider)->ScoredEvent, weighted sum over EXACT design 6.1 weights, one ScoreComponent per ScoreFactor with raw_value/weight/contribution/note; order_events() tie-break cancelled-last, score desc, earlier start_time, title asc; explanation.py build_explanation(components,*,verification_state)). pipeline/ (orchestrator.py run(window,*,repository,sources,location_provider,config)->RunReport threading ingest->normalize->dedup->verify->score->save; idempotent upsert by dedup_key; _diff_history appends EventHistory for changed tracked fields; seed_demo(*,repository,config,today=None) retargets fixture dates onto target day via _RetargetingSourceAdapter; provenance/conflict values coerced JSON-safe before save). CLI: python -m vandy_food_radar [--db PATH] {seed,run} (cli.py + __main__.py). web/ Flask (app.py create_app(config,*,repository,sources=None,location_provider=None,today_provider=None) reads ONLY through Repository; templates/index.html + _event_card.html + static/app.css dense cards; wsgi.py build_app reads VFR_DB default store.db). LAUNCH: make demo (seeds store.db then serves) -> http://127.0.0.1:5000/ ; or make seed + make web; or uv run python -m vandy_food_radar --db store.db seed. DB PATH: store.db (on-disk SQLite, gitignored runtime artifact; :memory: in tests). WEB ROUTES: GET / ranked index; POST /refresh re-run pipeline for tomorrow -> redirect /; POST /seed seed corpus -> redirect /; GET /static/app.css. BUGFIX (dedup): _canonical_member tie-break was source_record_id (fresh UUID per ingest) making dedup_key unstable across runs and breaking idempotent upsert; changed to content-only key (title tokens, title len, title/location lexical, start time) so keys are stable run-to-run. Added flask via uv add flask. Verification GREEN: pytest tests/test_ranking.py tests/test_web.py tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py (11 passed); uv run python -m vandy_food_radar seed; make check (ruff+black+mypy --strict+pytest, 90 passed). make demo starts the server; page shows ranked fixture events with cancelled Outdoor Movie Night last.
